description: Plinthed 1990 in front of the Air Force Command building; removed around 2022 for the II/331 bypass works; restored over more than two years and re-erected on the roundabout in front of Jaselská kasárna on 7 April 2024 by the 26th Command Control and Reconnaissance Regiment; the unit records the aircraft's service nickname "Evina" after the wife of its last technician Jiří Majer at Žatec; the tactical number 4401 comes from a Czech monument gazetteer and should be checked against the airframe
